title: Slime King and Unicorn
description: A large blue melting slime creature wearing a golden crown holds a scepter while standing on a dripping purple cliff. A white unicorn with a crescent moon body and flowing mane stands beside it under a purple night sky with a crescent moon, a castle, and smaller blue slimes floating around.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a large melting blue slime king with yellow eyes and golden crown holding a scepter, standing on a dripping purple cliff beside a white unicorn with long flowing mane and crescent moon body, small blue slimes floating in the air, distant castle on a rock, dramatic purple swirling night sky with large crescent moon, melting drips and vibrant colors, whimsical and strange atmosphere
